title: A ferritin–CRP interaction does not robustly improve cross-cycle resting-pulse prediction in women aged 20–49
abstract: In NHANES 2005–06 to 2009–10 women aged 20–49 complete cases, one log-ferritin × log-CRP term did not improve resting-pulse prediction beyond flexible marginal hematology and demographic measures: target MSE change +0.0466 bpm², with source-refit/target-PSU 95% interval −0.9188 to +2.5759.
